prerequisites: Electronics and electricity: operational amplifier, electrical circuits.

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to select, size and implement a sensor or a set of sensors associated with a measurement or production system and meeting a set of specifications.
Know the main sensors and associated conditioners

syllabus_topics: Fundamental principles: definitions, active sensors, passive sensors, composite sensors, influence quantities, sensor components, transmitter and measurement chain.
Metrological characteristics: measurement errors, qualities of a measurement chain, measurement range, limits of use, calibration, sensitivity.
Passive sensor conditioners: characteristics, potentiometers, measurement bridges.
Signal conditioners: adaptation, differential amplifier, isolation amplifier.
Sensors for mechanical quantities: deformation, displacement, force, torque, acceleration and vibration sensors.
Sensors in production systems: contact and non-contact detection, current, position and speed sensors, contact and non-contact temperature sensors, pressure and flow sensors.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
